name: Footer
description: a page or section footer area
status: stable — exercised in composed page flows under e2e and axe, beyond the per-component checks
aria: `contentinfo` landmark role -- provided natively by the `<footer>` element, allowing screen reader users to navigate directly to the footer
`aria-label` -- optional accessible name to distinguish this footer from others on the page
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (default: undefined) -- optional accessible name via `aria-label`, useful when multiple footers exist
